newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Semen Gresik says 1996 sales up 11.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Semen Gresik says 1996 sales up 11.7 pct.

text.p: Indonesia's largest cement maker PT Semen Gresik said on Tuesday it had posted consolidated sales of 9.54 million tonnes of cement in 1996, an increase of 11.7 percent against sales of 8.53 million tonnes the previous year.

The company said in a statement that its sales included 277,892 tonnes of cement exported to some Asian countries by its subsidiary PT Semen Padang and 15,836 tonnes sold to Singapore by another subsidiary PT Semen Tonasa.
Semen Gresik said the consolidated sales increase was partly due to a sharp increase in the cement sales of Semen Tonasa.
Semen Tonasa sold 2.2 million tonnes of cement in 1996, or up 33.5 percent against 1.66 million tonnes the previous year.
The statement did not give further details.
